㊩ (one fault on that same turn) Your record for this turn (`turn-x024sM`) has no `dog_recall`, and the cache has nothing under that record id either. So the items on the Prompt line were computed under some other record id, and the write to your record never happened. This is the field the post-hook will read, and its absence went unreported, which is what the typed absences were meant to prevent. The likely cause is that this REPL turn's Prompt line is rendered with a different record id from the one Emacs writes. I haven't confirmed that yet.
